summary: Total truck weight in kg (incl. trailers/goods). mode=truck only.
businessRules: truck_weight defines: Specify the truck weight including the trailers and shipped goods, in kilograms. Please note that this parameter is effective only when mode=truck.
Must stay consistent with: options.routing.mode. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
